findings.evidence: The deploy path forwarded none of CHAT_AI_* or NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_ENABLED, so following the runbook left chat silently off.
findings.why_it_matters: Without plumbing the feature could not be turned on in the Docker deploy.
findings.required_action: None. Not yet exercised by a real deploy (stated in the runbook).
findings.resolution: services.yml passes all 11 CHAT_AI_* variables with application.yml defaults (disabled, empty key and model); practice.Dockerfile has ARG/ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_ENABLED=false; deploy.yml passes the build arg; documented in the runbook and checklist.

findings.evidence: The AI chat section had been inserted in the middle of the CI/CD section.
findings.resolution: Section moved to the end of the README.

findings.evidence: The report overstated what ChatPromptSuiteDataTest protects.
findings.why_it_matters: A loosened pass rule would still pass the data test.
findings.resolution: The report now states the data test pins shape, not rule contents, which are protected by review and git history.

findings.evidence: For off-topic verdicts the parser discards the model text, so leak rules in group b cannot fail in a live run.
findings.why_it_matters: A green group b run would be misread as evidence of prompt-leak resistance.
findings.resolution: The report states that leak safety for off-topic verdicts is by construction.

findings.evidence: The live factory applied only the model prefix guard, not the production validator.
findings.why_it_matters: A live run could measure a configuration production rejects.
findings.resolution: create() calls ChatAiPropertiesValidator.requireValid first; Javadoc updated.

findings.evidence: A test count that did not match the report, and a cross-reference to a checklist item that was missing.
findings.why_it_matters: Mismatched figures reduce trust in the handoff.
findings.resolution: Figures aligned (3794 tests, 0 failures) and the UI/UX designer item added to the checklist.

findings.evidence: Rollback turned the backend off first although the web flag is build-time.
findings.why_it_matters: The panel stays visible and failing for the length of a web build.
findings.resolution: Rollback now starts the web rebuild first or in parallel and states what students see meanwhile.

findings.evidence: The live prompt suite (54 cases x 3 runs) has not been run: no Gemini key was available. max-tokens 800 is not yet confirmed against real token counts.
findings.why_it_matters: Prompt behaviour and the MAX_TOKENS ceiling are unmeasured against the real model.
findings.required_action: Run ChatPromptSuiteLiveTest with a paid key before enabling in production (mandatory item in checklist B).

findings.evidence: Paid Gemini key, budget alert and RPM/TPM/RPD limits are unchecked items.
findings.why_it_matters: Cost and rate-limit safety depend on account setup that code cannot provide.
findings.required_action: Tech Lead/PM complete the items in checklist B and runbook section 4.

findings.evidence: Legal review of the disclaimer and Privacy Policy/ToS text and the retention period are open; there is no retention or deletion mechanism.
findings.why_it_matters: Chat questions are stored; enabling without a legal decision is a compliance risk.
findings.required_action: Legal approval and a retention decision before enabling.

findings.evidence: The manual end-to-end browser check against a real backend has not been done; the UI was only checked against a mock API.
findings.why_it_matters: Integration across both services is unverified in a real browser.
findings.required_action: Run the manual pass in a real environment before enabling.

findings.evidence: The report recorded only Maven runs, not the final frontend commands.
findings.why_it_matters: The handoff needs final-state evidence for the frontend.
findings.resolution: Frontend results added: typecheck 0 errors, eslint 0 errors plus 1 old warning, vitest 64 files / 560 tests, build exit 0 on retry; the Next.js security advisory is a separate decision.

findings.evidence: The runbook described deploy-production.yml as only lint, test and build, but it also deploys over SSH and rebuilds web-practice on every push to main.
findings.why_it_matters: A missing NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_ENABLED in the VPS .env would silently turn the panel off after an unrelated deploy.
findings.resolution: Reworded after the verify run: the workflow deploys by SSH and rebuilds web-practice each time, so NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_ENABLED must stay set in the pte-api .env on the VPS.
